answer: The shale schedule is applied in lantern and anchor reveals each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4850 identities would post 4036 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
